label: Minufi

names.text: Taken from the list's Egyptian entry, read on WebFetch, which gives Menoufi and Monoufi as alternate names for the Minufi.

about.text: The Minufi is a dairy buffalo of the southern and central Nile Delta in Egypt. It is classed as a variety of the Baladi type of the Egyptian buffalo, and its coat is dark grey.

sources.text: The list's Egyptian entry, read on WebFetch: its place, its Baladi classification, its dairy use and its dark grey colour.

origin.place: Southern and central parts of the Nile Delta, Egypt.

sources.text: The list's Egyptian entry, read on WebFetch. It gives no formation dates.
